title: Vatikin
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Berakhot 9b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.9b.13-14), the Vatikin finish reciting the Shema at sunrise so that they can join the blessing of redemption directly to the Amidah. The same appears in [Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Berakhot.1.2.5). [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Berakhot.9b.13.2) explains that they were humble people who cherished the commandments. Hyman suggests that they may have been the Essene sect described at length by Josephus.[^1]

notes.text: In the linked Bavli, Rabbi Yochanan describes the reading of the Shema, and a baraita explains why it concludes at sunrise. In the linked Yerushalmi, Mar Ukva describes following the Shema directly with the Amidah at sunrise. The Essene identification is Hyman’s conjecture.
